description: Search upcoming travel-worthy events in every What's Up In city at once: where an artist, band, comedian or team is playing, which cities have a festival, conference or expo, big arena shows, games and races. Only events worth a trip are indexed (named performers, festivals, conferences/expos, arena shows, games, races), not every local listing: for everything in one city (small gigs, classes, meetups) use search_events with its city. Kind `residency` also searches a worldwide list of residencies (pop-up cities, hacker houses, founder and research residencies, fellowship cohorts; most outside our cities, e.g. Kobe or Goa; in person, hybrid or remote; fixed dates, a start only, or rolling intake), each with its application details. Give a `query`, at least one of `kinds`, or a place. Each result names its city and links to the original listing (`link`) and the event on that city's site (`on_site`); `searched` says which cities were included and how fresh each is. No sign-in; each client gets 30 calls a minute and 2,500 event rows an hour.

cities.description: Only these cities (names or slugs): Boston, Chicago, Los Angeles, Orange County, Sacramento, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Albuquerque, Almaty, Anchorage, Atlanta, Baltimore, Bangkok, Beijing, Berlin, Buffalo, Cairo, Cancún, Cape Town, Cincinnati, Cleveland, Colorado Springs & Pueblo, Dallas-Fort Worth, DC, Denver, Detroit, Fresno, Guangzhou, Havana, Honolulu, Houston, Inland Empire, Kansas City, Las Vegas, London, Mexico City, Miami, Minneapolis-St. Paul, Montreal, Nashville, New Orleans, New York, Paris, Philadelphia, Phoenix, Pittsburgh, Portland, Raleigh, Richmond, Rome, Salt Lake City, San Antonio, San Juan, Savannah, Seoul, Shanghai, St. Louis, Sydney, Tokyo, Toronto, Vancouver. Default: all.

kinds.description: Only these kinds: act = named performers; festival = festival; major = major local festival; conference = conference / expo; big_show = arena or amphitheater show; game = sports game (any level); pro_game = professional sports game (MLB, NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, WNBA, NWSL); race = race; residency = residency, pop-up city, hacker house or fellowship cohort, worldwide (most are outside our cities); in person, hybrid or remote, fixed dates or rolling intake: see each result's residency.attendance and residency.schedule.

near.description: "lat,lon": only events within radius_km of it, with distance_km. (search_events also takes place names.) Unmapped venues are left out (place.unplaced_events).

neighborhood.description: Only events in this neighborhood or town (whole words, e.g. 'Silver Lake', 'South End', 'Pasadena'). Events whose venue isn't mapped can't be placed and are left out; place.unplaced_events counts them.

query.description: An artist, band, comedian, team, festival or conference name, or words to match in titles/performers/venues, e.g. 'Khruangbin', 'Oktoberfest', 'AI summit'. Optional when `kinds`, `neighborhood` or `near` is given.

trip_only.description: Only events worth a special trip (multi-day festivals, festivals on a city's watchlist, arena/amphitheater shows, multi-day conferences, full-distance races). Default: true when there is no query, false when searching a name.

name: search_across_cities

event_status.description: sold_out, postponed, rescheduled or moved when a source says so (as in search_events)

on_site.description: The event on that city's site

residency.description: Residencies (kind `residency`): program details from its official page

application.description: open, rolling, closed, invite or unknown

apply_deadline.description: YYYY-MM-DD when the program states one

attendance.description: in_person, hybrid (in person with a remote option) or remote

cost.description: free, stipend, sponsored, paid or unknown (never a price)

kind.description: popup_city, hacker_house, founder_residency, research_residency, artist_residency, fellowship or other

schedule.description: fixed (start and end), start_only (no stated end) or rolling (ongoing intake; `date` is today)

looser_matches.description: Weaker matches left out (the query only in a title or venue)

residencies_worldwide.description: The worldwide residencies list the `residency` kind also searches

searched.description: Which cities were searched and how fresh each is

title: Search events across all cities
